# Paintings {#sec-paintings}

Paintings are items of type *painting* (Q15) in the CPS Wikibase. Most of them are also typed as *artwork*.

```{python}
#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / "src"))

from baldessari import cps, plots, table, works_table
paintings = cps.paintings()
```

The CPS Wikibase contains **`{python} len(paintings)`** paintings.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-paintings
#| tbl-cap: "Paintings in the CPS Wikibase."
table(works_table(paintings))
```

## Materials

```{python}
#| label: tbl-painting-materials
#| tbl-cap: "Materials used for paintings, by number of paintings."
mats = (
    paintings["materials"].str.split("; ").explode().replace("", None).dropna()
    .value_counts().rename_axis("Material").reset_index(name="Paintings")
)
table(mats)
```

## Dimensions

```{python}
#| label: fig-painting-sizes
#| fig-cap: "Height and width of paintings with recorded dimensions."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

sized = paintings.dropna(subset=["height", "width"])
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
ax.scatter(sized["width"], sized["height"], color="#3366CC")
ax.set_xlabel("Width (cm)")
ax.set_ylabel("Height (cm)")
ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.close(fig)
fig
```

@fig-painting-sizes plots the `{python} len(sized)` paintings for which both height and width are recorded.
